stage_designation.quote: The stage, designated stage 66 (inlet guide vanes, rotor 66, stator 66) has a design pressure ratio of 1. 61 at a design weight flow of 29. 7 kilograms per second. Design efficiency for the stage is 0. 863.

origin.value: first stage (with IGVs) of a 51-cm-diameter five-stage compressor, design weight flow 29.7 kg/s, pressure ratio 9.27
origin.quote: a 51-centimeter-diameter, five-stage compressor having a design weight flow of 29.7 kilograms per second with a pressure ratio of 9.27 was fabricated and tested with inlet guide vanes (IGV's).

design_stage_pressure_ratio_text.quote: This stage was designed for an overall pressure ratio of 1. 61 at a weight flow of 29.7 kilograms per second (196 (kg/sec)/m2 of annulus area). Design stage efficiency (rotor inlet to stator outlet) is 0.863.

design_weight_flow_text.quote: This stage was designed for an overall pressure ratio of 1. 61 at a weight flow of 29.7 kilograms per second (196 (kg/sec)/m2 of annulus area).

design_tip_speed_text.quote: The design tip speed was 426 meters per second.

rotor_tip_solidity.quote: The rotor and stator were designed for tip solidities of 1. 4 and 1. 5, respectively.

stator_tip_solidity.quote: The rotor and stator were designed for tip solidities of 1. 4 and 1. 5, respectively.

rotor_blade_count.quote: The rotor had 57 blades with an aspect ratio of 3.1 and the stator had 64 blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 7.

rotor_aspect_ratio.quote: The rotor had 57 blades with an aspect ratio of 3.1

stator_blade_count.quote: the stator had 64 blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 7.

stator_aspect_ratio.quote: the stator had 64 blades with an aspect ratio of 2. 7.

rotor_design_pressure_ratio_radial.quote: This rotor was designed for a radially constant total pressure ratio of 1.62.

rotor_profile.quote: The rotor has multiple circular-arc blade shapes while the stator had a double circular-arc blade shape.

stator_profile.quote: The rotor has multiple circular-arc blade shapes while the stator had a double circular-arc blade shape.

blade_element_surfaces.value: blade elements on conical surfaces; stacked on a line through their centers of gravity
blade_element_surfaces.quote: to compute blade elements on conical surfaces passing through the blade row. In this program the blade elements are then stacked on a line passing through their centers of gravity

igv_profile.quote: The vanes utilized multiple circular-arc blade profiles.

igv_blade_count.quote: There were 26 vanes having a tip solidity of 1. 0 and an aspect ratio of 2.4.

igv_tip_solidity.quote: There were 26 vanes having a tip solidity of 1. 0 and an aspect ratio of 2.4.

igv_aspect_ratio.quote: There were 26 vanes having a tip solidity of 1. 0 and an aspect ratio of 2.4.

igv_max_thickness_location.unit: percent of chord from leading edge (approximately)
igv_max_thickness_location.quote: Maximum thickness location was at approximately 37 percent of chord from the leading edge.

igv_setting.value: two segments pivoted at the max-thickness location; rear segment adjustable; all tests with vanes aligned axially
igv_setting.quote: The vanes were made in two segments that could be pivoted at the maximum thickness location. The forward section was stationary while the rear segment was adjustable for varying rotor inlet prewhirl. All tests in this report were conducted with the vanes alined in the axial direction.

rotor_part_span_damper.value: about 40 percent span from the outlet rotor tip; max damper thickness 0.180 cm
rotor_part_span_damper.quote: The rotor blades have vibration dampers located at about 40 percent span from the outlet rotor tip. The maximum thickness of the damper is 0.180 centimeter.

rotor_tip_clearance_cold.quote: The nonrotating radial tip clearance of the rotor was a nominal 0. 05 centimeter at ambient conditions.

igv_hub_te_to_rotor_hub_le.quote: the axial spacing between the IGV hub trailing edge and rotor hub leading edge was 2. 50 centimeters.

rotor_hub_te_to_stator_hub_le.quote: The axial spacing between the rotor hub trailing edge and the stator hub leading edge was 2. 66 centimeters.

igv_blade_passage_angle.quote: One IGVblade passage is 13. 87° and one stator blade passage is 5.63°.

stator_blade_passage_angle.quote: One IGVblade passage is 13. 87° and one stator blade passage is 5.63°.

survey_stations.quote: 0 instrumentation plane upstream of inlet guide vanes / 1 instrumentation plane upstream of rotor / 2 instrumentation plane between rotor and stator / 3 instrumentation plane downstream of stator
